As part of the training in becoming an [[elementalist]], assist [[Elementalist Aziure]] in her arcane research and protect her from [[Ice Elemental Shard|ice beasts]] while she develops a powerful new [[elite skill]].

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = elementalist
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Use your [[Fire Storm]] spell to defeat the ice beasts that attack Aziure.
* Return to Elementalist Aziure for your reward.

=== Early benefits ===
* Aziure will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill_icon|Aura of Restoration}}
** {{skill_icon|Fire Storm}}
** {{skill_icon|Glyph of Lesser Energy}}

=== Reward ===
* 250 [[Experience]]

== Walkthrough ==
Upon accepting the quest, simply wait for the [[Ice Elemental Shard]]s to [[spawn]]. They come periodically in three waves. Since the Ice Elemental Shards take double damage from fire, a single, well-placed [[Fire Storm]] will easily kill them even with 0 [[Fire Magic]]. Wait until they cluster around you or Aziure, cast the spell once they stop moving, and watch them melt.

Once the final wave is defeated, speak to Aziure to claim your reward.
== NPCs ==

=== Foes ===
[[Elemental]]s
* {{e}} 1 [[Ice Elemental Shard]]

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
; Elementalist Aziure
: ''"Perhaps you can help me with a spell I am working on. [[The Order]] has asked me to investigate the disciplines of [[Water Magic]], and so I have worked very hard to ready this place for the final casting. But each time I attempt to cast my wards, '''ice beasts''' appear and attack me, and I have to stop what I'm doing to fend them off. I will give you the skills necessary to defeat them. If you can just keep them from hurting me too much, I should be able to finish researching the [[Ward Against Harm]] spell. What do you say?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready.
| decline = No, not right now.
| ask = I am still preparing for the final cast. Be on the lookout for those '''ice beasts''' and keep your Fire Storm ready. Best to wait for them to stop moving before you cast.
}}

If you take the quest but leave and change your secondary before killing the Ice Elementals Shards, the intermediate dialog will become ''"I can't give you any skills since you've already chosen not to take Elementalist as your secondary profession. I think it's unlikely you'll be able to finish this quest."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Elementalist Aziure
: ''"Well done! The ward works, but it is still very unstable. It will no doubt take me years to perfect it.''

: ''"Your understanding of magic use is impressive."''

== Notes ==
* If Aziure is killed you cannot accept the reward for this quest, so kill the Ice Elemental Shards before they can kill her.
* Unlocks [[Elementalist]] for [[Profession#Secondary profession|secondary profession]].
* Some players may find it worthwhile to repeatedly do the quest for experience and drops, [[zone|zoning]] back to [[Foible's Fair]], abandoning the quest and going back to Aziure. However, the Ice Elemental Shards are level 1 (compared to the standard level 3 [[Ice Elemental]]s) and do not drop [[Icy Lodestones]].
